rows.note: Use this for the disposal or recycling of waste, rather than for hygiene policy generally.

example.english: The sanitation of waste in this area is handled well, and the streets are much cleaner.
example.traditional: 呢區嘅垃圾處理做得幾好，街道乾淨好多。
example.jyutping: ni1 keoi1 ge3 laap6 saap3 cyu5 lei5 zou6 dak1 gei2 hou2 gaai1 dou6 gon1 zing6 hou2 do1

rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for sanitation as general hygiene and health protection.

example.english: The school has improved sanitation by requiring students to wash their hands before eating.
example.traditional: 學校加強衛生，要求學生食飯前洗手。
example.jyutping: hok6 haau6 gaa1 koeng4 wai6 sang1 jiu1 kau4 hok6 saang1 sik6 faan6 cin4 sai2 sau2
